description: Compact schematic SVG render of the board (typically a few kB even for dense boards). Returns both an image/svg+xml content block and the raw SVG in `structuredContent.svg`. The schematic labels Mermaid diagrams without rendering their nodes. CALL THIS any time you need to understand where things are — before placing new items, before deciding whether the canvas is crowded, before picking a free region. AI-authored items get a purple border so you can tell which contributions were yours. For precise text content prefer `get_board`.

access_key.description: Board key for direct MCP clients that handle credentials outside chat. Accepts an 8-character key or a legacy 6-character key. Keep the key out of chat and use the browser or an MCP client configured with the X-Board-Key header.

name: get_preview
